label: Identity
description: What the sign-in graphs need from the outside: a directory's verdict on a credential, and our tokens. Bound by identity.binding.json to the @auth plugin and the two directories written in connections/; a production profile binds it to real directories.

verifyCustomer.description: Ask the customer directory about a credential.

verifyEmployee.description: Ask the employee directory about a credential.

issue.description: Sign our access token for a subject and open its session with the attributes given.

refresh.description: Trade a refresh token for a new pair, when it is good.
